name: respire
description: respire memory for ZCode: every-round title-tier recall, pending prefix handoff and Bash write guard, model-optional degradation. Works fully offline; only encrypted records reach the cloud; enterprises can self-host the sync server. On-machine registration via rsrs register; the sidecar model is an optional boost.

description_i18n.zh-CN: respire 本地加密记忆（ZCode 插件）：每轮标题档自动召回、「记：」前缀交主模型审查后落库、Bash 写前防护；不装模型也完全可用，仅加密记录上云，企业可自托管同步服务。本机 rsrs register 注册，端侧模型为可选增强。
